notes.title: Chapter 3 Progress Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

I’m thrilled to bring you an exciting update on the progress of [b]Chapter 3[/b] and give you a sneak peek at what’s coming next! The journey of creating this chapter has been both challenging and rewarding, and I truly appreciate all of your patience and enthusiasm. Your feedback and support are what drive this project forward, and I can’t wait to share what I’ve been working on with you. Today, I’ll be providing insight into the improvements being made, the current progress, and why this upcoming update will be bigger and better than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/a0a80a994cbdc8ddd6f91cb1e2bc4c6932f6615f.png[/img]

After carefully reviewing feedback from Chapter 2, I’ve been making improvements to enhance the overall experience. Two major points stood out: the length of updates and the quantity of erotic animations. With that in mind, Chapter 3 will not only be [b]longer[/b] but will also feature [b]more detailed and immersive erotic scenes[/b], including additional angles and poses to make each moment feel even more dynamic and engaging. These changes aim to deliver a richer and more satisfying experience while maintaining the quality that you love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/958a6c362ce53f701ba5359d8b0b3acd768bef46.png[/img]

I also want to acknowledge that the development time has been very slow, and I understand that waiting for new content can be frustrating. Creating a chapter with meaningful improvements takes time, and I want to ensure that every scene, animation, and story moment is carefully crafted to meet expectations. I truly appreciate your patience, and I’m doing my best to make sure the wait is worthwhile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/dccd441cf2f7c4ce8ccadeb1c43ffc82151c06e4.png[/img]

As of now, [b]65% of the update is complete[/b], and everything is progressing smoothly toward delivering a polished and rewarding chapter. Every new addition, from the extended scenes to the refined animations, is being carefully designed to make this the best chapter yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/58bb7ec7f10e7808bc3fff0b6695f3533365d0c2.png[/img]

I want to sincerely thank you all for your continued patience and support. Your passion for this game and its story is what makes developing each chapter so fulfilling. I promise that Chapter 3 will be worth the anticipation, and I can’t wait to share it with you when it's fully ready! ❤

For more previews, feel free to follow Dokiden on [url=https://x.com/DokidenGames]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

After a lengthy wait, I am happy to announce that [b]Chapter 2[/b] is finally at the very end of its development and will be [b]coming to Steam this March[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/b946d76a2db189c3965ca342351b71566830c1ee.png[/img]

The update will feature more than 2x as many renders as Chapter 1 did. And, of course, all of them will have panning animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/a26078388e223898d7ae6b5aa938c63dc9374518.png[/img]

Chapter 2 will also have 4x more fully animated erotic scenes than Chapter 1. All of them will be spread out through multiple different story paths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/64fd4718f622b270e1a2e6d57978aef43334b3dc.png[/img]

Lastly, the update will hide 12 new collectable cards, introduce minor improvements to Chapter 1, add the macOS version, and Steam achievements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/f332ea2d0bc6ee1e1db7ee03c28335dbf462b468.png[/img]

I am really excited for you to play it!!

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I want to update you on the upcoming chapter's development progress and answer a few of your questions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/a7686fc68c5c843980eae564ee084b178f602ddd.png[/img]

[b]What is the progress on the new update, and when is it ready to be released?[/b]

I have recently finished developing Part 1 of Chapter 2 (you can see all of the preview pictures from it in this post), and I am now working on Part 2 of the update. Steam will get an update of a complete Chapter 2 (with both parts).

I originally planned for the update to be released to Steam by June. However, due to various issues, the release will be pushed back a bit later into the summer of 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/1cf264a32570701494234acc88537980e6d262fa.png[/img]

[b]What will the new update include?[/b]

Chapter 1 was an introduction to the game, and it lacked the space to showcase some important gameplay features. One of which is different story paths. Contrary to Chapter 1, Chapter 2 will have several different routes a player can take based on their picked choices in both chapters.

Chapter 2 will also have more content than Chapter 1. It is difficult to say the exact proportions while the update is yet to be fully finished, but what is definite is that Chapter 2 will have at least 2x longer story and at least 3x more erotic animations than Chapter 1. 

The game will also get Steam achievements and potentially a few language translations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/0e686a08b368a0ad341201db5e346893c78d7ff6.png[/img]

[b]Why is the development so slow, and will it always take so long for new updates to come out?[/b]

The main reason the update development is taking long is that I work on the game alone, and currently, I can only make it during my free time as a part-time job. With the upcoming update being paid and thus increasing the development budget, things can only change for the better regarding the waiting gap between updates following Chapter 2. 

[b]Why do you release the game in chapters and not the full game?[/b]

Getting smaller revenue from each update and reinvesting it into faster development time is the quickest way I can finish the entire game.

[b]How many chapters will there be?[/b]

The game has a well-planned storyline which will end with Chapter 5. 

[b]How much will one chapter cost?[/b]

It is difficult to say until I have the update ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/7e25b7249ad12cfd4b461cd6570ad670d86324ce.png[/img]

[b]Are there more previews of Chapter 2?[/b]

Yes. From now I will occasionally be posting preview images from Part 1 of Chapter 2 on my Twitter account:
https://twitter.com/DokidenGames


I hope this update information was helpful, and apologies for the long wait,

Dokiden

notes.title: Dreamland's Development Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

As requested by the community, I wish to share Dreamland’s development roadmap. This will hopefully answer some of your questions and give a better understanding of where the project is headed.

[h3]Dreamland’s Roadmap:[/h3]

Dreamland’s full story is set to last 1 in-game week and will feature multiple endings, plot twists and romance scenes depending on your choices.

The game will be split into multiple small chapters. Each chapter will be released separately as a new major update to the game as DLC (most likely paid). 

The next major update will be “Chapter II” and it is on course to be released within the first half of 2023 as originally planned. 

Chapter II preview:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43086914/17ac87d0a7687b05d4f90a281969b30bcc78c7ed.png[/img]

Upcoming features to Chapter II:[list]
[*]More story. New update will conclude day 1 and will feature the entire day 2.
[*]Choices will matter and they will alter the story.
[*]5 new fully animated erotic scenes.
[*]10 new collectible cards.
[*]Addition of special awards for collecting a certain number of cards.
[/list]
I work on the game alone and, as of writing this, part-time, thus the long wait for the new update. However, I do try and spend as many hours on the development as I can and I hope that in the future the waiting time between new chapters will be reduced.

Hopefully this roadmap has provided some useful information about the project and I look forward to sharing the upcoming chapter with you all in the foreseeable future.

Dokiden
